Name: Slay
Author: GamerWitchVic
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Slay is SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley. Every time an NPC finishes a conversation with you, your farmer will say "Slay." It doesn't touch any dialogue, quests, or save data — it just adds a little chaos to every conversation. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

To uninstall, just delete the "Slay" folder from your Mods folder.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Shows a "Slay." speech bubble above your farmer's head after any NPC conversation ends.
- Also triggers after scripted events/cutscenes finish.
- Uses the game's own speech-bubble art and fade animation, so it looks like it belongs.
- Optimized to not spam you (too much slay isn't slay)[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI 4.5.2 or later ([url=https://smapi.io]smapi.io[/url])
- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
- No other mods required.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Pathoschild, for SMAPI
- The Stardew Valley modding community and wiki, for documenting the game's internals.[/color][/size]
